classes.institution_record_candidate: Structured country on the paper's institution or a same-snapshot institution-ID lookup, without contrary authorship evidence. Institutional history and overseas campus attribution still require review.
classes.explicit_country_text_candidate: A complete country-name address segment, with no contrary institution/authorship evidence. It is a rule-based candidate, not a human-validated country label.
classes.institution_and_text_candidate: Both structured institution and explicit text provide accepted evidence for the previously UNKNOWN Work. Source-country sets and every evidence decision remain available.
classes.existing_country_set_extension: A previously country-known Work gains evidence from an unlabelled authorship; separate approval is needed because country fractional weights can change.
classes.mixed_evidence_review_only: An independent valid candidate and other conflicting evidence coexist on the same Work. The full rule result and the subset excluding whole-Work conflicts are both reported.
classes.conflict_or_ambiguity_review_only: Contradiction or ambiguous geography; no confidence probability or automatic replacement is assigned.
classes.secondary_geo_name_review_only: Same-snapshot institution.geo.country name matched through typed-country crosswalk; source code was missing. No reverse geocoder or institution-brand inference is used.
classes.secondary_exact_dictionary_review_only: An exact normalized raw affiliation is supported by at least five distinct Works, one country and one explicit institution group, with address specificity. Holdout consistency is not human-reviewed accuracy.
